projects.title: AI Mode in Chrome Search
projects.summary: Working on bringing the power of AI Mode to Chrome Search through adding tabs as context and driving deep multimodal and multi-context queries.

projects.title: EV information on Search
projects.summary: On the Electric Vehicle team in Google Search, migrated a desktop UI feature on car searches from a legacy framework to a new one, more efficiently displaying EV financial incentives and charging information. Authored a detailed design document in collaboration with PM, UX design, and engineering, and developed the UI logic integrated with a high-performance C++ backend.

projects.title: Quantum services health dashboard
projects.summary: Created a dashboard displaying a graph-like diagram of the health of about 10 microservices running jobs on IBM's Quantum Computer, along with dependencies between services — empowering engineers to respond to outages by visually surfacing affected dependencies. Built full-stack with Vue.js, Node.js, Express.js, Socket.io, PostgreSQL, and the PagerDuty API, with code quality enforced via Jest and Travis CI.

projects.title: Chaos engineering for OPCC
projects.summary: Built a full-stack project injecting failures into Dell's On-Premise Cloud Control (OPCC) software used by Dell's APEX Cloud Services, using Chaos Engineering to test system robustness. Developed a Chaos Engine to inject failures, a responsive UI for developers to choose failure types and view detailed response logs, and a REST API server to handle data between the UI and engine. Used Litmus, a Kubernetes framework, to manage chaos workflows.
